description: Defines the TimesheetActionLog entity class for ORM, representing logs of actions performed on timesheets in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log entry for actions performed on a timesheet, including details like action type, comment, date, user who performed it, and associated timesheet.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the log entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the log entry.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the log.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment associated with the log.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the log entry.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the log entry.

methods.name: getPerformedUser
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedUser
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the action.
